limitations: The retained PDFs are labeled official U.S. House primary results by the New Jersey Division of Elections, but this receipt does not retain a separate signed or sealed cycle-level certification instrument.
Source winner and incumbent markers are retained exactly, including marker-only continuation lines in the 2022 and 2024 district 12 sections; no winner is inferred from vote totals.
Source incumbent markers and candidate names are retained as printed; they are not current-incumbent identity bindings or progressive classifications.
Candidate street addresses remain in the byte-retained public source PDFs but are deliberately excluded from the derived receipt and its text fields.
No contest is public, score eligible, historical-geography approved, or evaluator integrated.
